# Public-data correspondence for situated recovery

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`situated-recovery-empirical-correspondence` · **reviewed-scoped** · assessment · F04 · [record](situated-recovery-empirical-correspondence.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Public records from 16 participants support finite mean response retention and constrain the predictive scope of simple temporal curves; greater model complexity is not uniformly superior.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Use the author-provided force-compensation coefficient, FieldA direction and actual trials; the complete original processing has not been independently reproduced exactly.
- Eight participants per group; resample participants and reserve final 50 observations for scoring. Published findings were known, making this exploratory secondary analysis.
- Descriptive curves, baseline and extrapolation rules are explicit; the nonnegative-level constraint is a post hoc sensitivity preserving the original results.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Retention is supported over finite stages; no infinite-time limit is established.
- The curve comparison does not establish a unique mechanism.
- Mean response retention does not establish complete situational understanding or ethical convergence.
- It does not establish joint cross-scale biological validation.
- **Counterexample:** The baseline-corrected group-difference interval includes zero; simple decay wins mean spontaneous forecast error and a constant mean wins evoked error. Near-unit parameter instability and force reconstruction differences are retained. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/inquiry-correspondence/situated-recovery/README.md)

<a id="progress--已接通"></a>
## Progress

1. Public data: all 16 original recovery records are analysed at participant level, extending the six-study synthesis with actual measurement correspondence and held-out forecast evaluation. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/JOINT-RISK-REVISION-INTEGRATION.md#41-public-records-now-test-a-specific-correspondence)

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

18 original files retained; 16 MAT files match deposited hashes; 5,440 rows, 2,656 measurements and 800 held-out predictions pass data and arithmetic checks. Substantive self-review completed; no independent experiment, independent-agent review or new Lean theorem.

Canonical source: [README.md](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/inquiry-correspondence/situated-recovery/README.md)

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

Reuse the completed measurement correspondence. Stronger mechanism claims require discriminating experimental relations or existing intervention evidence, rather than waiting for our own laboratory.
